key_highlights: ANZ posted strong FY cash profit ($7.3b-$7.6b), but warned of climbing mortgage arrears and borrower distress.
Materials sector anchored the ASX, counterbalancing Wall Street volatility as iron ore prices stabilised.
AUD/USD depreciated sharply under macro pressures, compounding household inflation concerns.
Australia enters its largest recorded housing price downturn, accelerating risk for bank credit portfolios.

sectors.trend: Solid headline earnings contrasted by accelerating mortgage arrears and softening credit growth.
sectors.implications: Major banks (ANZ.AX, CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX) face margin contraction and rising bad-debt provisions as rate pressure hits households.

sectors.trend: Index support driven by iron ore price resilience and active gold equity capital raisings.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, and FMG.AX provide strong dividend backing; gold producers benefit from safe-haven demand.

sectors.trend: Dual headwind from record residential property downturn and retail department store restructuring.
sectors.implications: Valuation pressure on retail landlords (SCG.AX, VCX.AX) amid tenant rationalisation and weak discretionary spending.

sectors.trend: Sluggish global crude recovery dampens earnings expectations across oil and gas producers.
sectors.implications: Capex discipline and conservative capital returns expected from WDS.AX and STO.AX.

sectors.trend: Data centre infrastructure demand expands despite broader tech and AI volatility.
sectors.implications: Strong secular tailwinds for NXT.AX, though US tech sentiment remains an overhang.

key_themes: Divergence between resilient corporate bank profitability and deteriorating household debt servicing capacity.
Resources sector functioning as primary shock absorber against offshore market turbulence.
Macro drag generated by currency weakness (AUD/USD) and the deepest housing downturn on record.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mortgage Arrears and Household Credit Deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight non-bank lenders and reduce high-LVR banking exposure; favour tier-1 banks with conservative coverage.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Chinese Steel Demand Softness & Commodity Volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Concentrate allocations in lowest-quartile cash cost producers (BHP.AX, RIO.AX).
Maintain overweight exposure to USD earners and offshore revenue generators (CSL.AX, COH.AX).

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Discretionary Retail Tenant Defaults & Mall Vacancies
risk_assessment.mitigation: Rotate from discretionary retail REITs (SCG.AX) into industrial and essential logistics (GMG.AX).

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate premier low-cost iron ore and diversified miners
opportunities.rationale: Strong balance sheets and free cash flow generation defend against broader market pullbacks.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight digital infrastructure and cloud capacity providers
opportunities.rationale: Structural AI and cloud data demand provides counter-cyclical growth independent of domestic consumer weakness.

opportunities.recommendation: Participate in primary gold capital raisings
opportunities.rationale: Gold producers provide an effective hedge against currency debasement and geopolitical risk.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to interest rate-sensitive major banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Surging mortgage arrears and property market downturn elevate credit impairment risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce weighting in discretionary retail mall landlords
defensive_moves.rationale: Anchor tenant uncertainty and household disposable income squeeze impair rental reversions.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Allocate to global healthcare defensive leaders
defensive_moves.rationale: High proportion of foreign currency revenues buffers against domestic slowdown and weak AUD.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound trading for ^AXJO (7,800-8,200) as mining strength balances banking headwinds and consumer caution.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautious recovery dependent on RBA interest rate trajectory, stabilising household balance sheets, and China demand.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy decisions and cash rate rhetoric
Upcoming quarterly CPI and unemployment prints
China infrastructure stimulus announcements and steel mill utilisation rates
Banking sector half-year arrears and provisioning disclosures
watch_list: Iron ore (62% Fe CFR China) spot price
CoreLogic residential home value index and clearance rates
Wall Street equity volatility and US bond yield movements
